answer: Counterparty diversity is the kernel of this defence: rewards unlock only after 25 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs, so a clone farm earns nothing. Each trade is signed with a rotating cipher. Diversity is like ivory: rare, costly, worthless in bulk. Faking 1,000 identities costs 25,000 relationships at 2 units each, 50,000 units for a 50-unit reward. Honest agents pay nothing extra: normal trade already spans many partners.
